summary: Both backend and frontend tested for iteration 3 features (RSS-sourced feuds, full-text search, share endpoint, sources box, share button). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass — /api/search?q=Ferragni returns 2 matches, /api/search?q= returns [], /api/share/{id} returns revealed=true without auth and 404 for unknown ids, /api/admin/generate-daily?count=1 returned within ~5s a feud with 3 sources (title/link/source populated), and the existing 'Intercettazioni: FI contro FdI' feud has 3 sources including Repubblica links. Regression (anon login → home cards '?' pre-vote → vote → comment) still works. Frontend (mobile 390x844 web preview): anonymous login works, 11 feud cards render with '?' pre-vote, search-toggle reveals search-input, typing 'ferragni' + Enter filters to 2 matching cards, feud detail shows FONTI box with source-0/1/2 items (3 Repubblica links visible), share-button renders in topbar, voting reveals results and unlocks comment-input, submit-comment posts and comment appears. Console shows a pre-existing benign warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (already reported in iteration_2).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration. Reference: emitted at runtime when navigating auth->home.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/search correctly falls back from $text index to regex if index is missing — good resilience.
/api/share/{feud_id} strips my_vote and forces revealed=true and does not require auth — matches spec.
_fetch_headlines_for_category handles per-feed exceptions and dedups by title[:80].lower() — reasonable, could benefit from urlparse-based dedup by host+path but non-blocking.
_generate_feud_for_category attaches up to 3 sources (chosen + 2 refs); order preserved.
server.py is now 836 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting rss/, ai_gen/, auth/, feuds/ into modules in a future iteration.
Frontend api.ts encodes the search query with encodeURIComponent — correct.
feud/[id].tsx uses Share.share() from react-native which on web falls back to navigator.share or errors silently (wrapped in try/catch) — acceptable; the testID='share-button' is always visible.
seed_data_creation: Anonymous users TEST_SR_*, TEST_R_* created via /api/auth/anonymous; a test comment 'TEST regression comment' + 'TEST commento regressione' created; one AI-generated feud created by test_admin_generate_daily_creates_feud_with_sources (has sources, real RSS-based).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_3 features all pass. Search filters via $text index on title/summary/party_a/party_b. Share endpoint is public. AI-generate produces sources[]. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_search_share_sources.py can be re-used for regression. Frontend selectors: [data-testid=search-toggle], [data-testid=search-input], [data-testid=sources-box], [data-testid=source-0..N], [data-testid=share-button]. Login via anon: tab-anon → nickname-input → submit-button.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
